gh_7be2f05d46f630ed65453833.title: [远程] 头部数字资产与金融科技平台招聘：后端/Web3/智能合约/Flutter/前端/测试/SRE/AI/产品/设计 25K-50K RMB/月
gh_7be2f05d46f630ed65453833.description:
注：本帖为企业直招（非猎头）。公司名称面试阶段告知，可先通过下方邮箱/Telegram 沟通了解业务与团队。

## 公司/团队介绍
业务覆盖全球的头部数字资产与金融科技平台（名称面试阶段告知，企业直招）。业务线包括：现货/合约交易、Web3 钱包与链上交易、美股/股票代币、支付与虚拟卡、AI 量化 / AI Agent。团队分布在亚太多个国家和地区，以中文为主要工作语言，长期稳定招聘。

## 薪资福利待遇
- 技术岗：25K–50K RMB/月，按经验面议
- 产品、设计、风控、运营等其它岗位：同等水平面议
- 全远程办公，有竞争力的薪酬，全球化业务视野

## 地点
- 工作地点：全远程（亚太时区）
- 联系方式：简历发 zhuhongsheng2023@gmail.com（邮件标题：应聘职位-姓名-年限）；或 Telegram：@jasonzhu_talent

## 工作性质
- 是否全职：全职
- 是否远程：全远程
- 时区要求：亚太时区（GMT+8 优先，可覆盖核心工作时间，可适应国际分布式团队协作）
- 面试流程：线上 3 轮，1–2 周出结果
- 语言：中文流利

## 岗位要求、职责（每行：岗位｜核心要求）

### 后端 / 架构 / Web3
- Web3 后端开发工程师（钱包方向）｜Golang 实战、并发模型、钱包/链上交易系统
- 智能合约开发工程师（多链）｜Solidity / Rust / Move 等至少两种合约语言，熟悉主流公链
- 高级后端开发工程师（交易后端）｜Go / Java，高并发交易系统设计
- 交易系统核心开发（撮合引擎）｜低延迟、高性能撮合/行情系统，对微秒级延迟有追求
- 后端开发工程师（用户安全）｜CEX 用户安全、验证、风控类业务研发优先
- 爬虫工程师｜大规模数据采集，有海外平台数据采集经验
- 风控算法（AI Agent 方向）｜Python/SQL，风控算法与服务落地

### 移动端 / 前端
- APP 开发工程师（AI 量化 / AI 提效 / Money·虚拟卡 / iPhone Duo）｜Android / iOS / Flutter 至少精通一端，交易/行情/支付类 APP 经验优先
- Web3 Flutter 开发工程师（钱包 App）｜Flutter 架构与性能，钱包类 App 经验
- Web3 高级前端开发工程师（钱包前端）｜前端架构设计，Web3 / DApp 经验
- APP 性能治理专家｜崩溃、OOM、启动、卡顿等性能与稳定性治理，有量化成果

### 测试
- Web3 测试开发工程师｜交易所 / Web3 业务测试经验，钱包、swap 等链上业务，接口与 APP 自动化
- APP 测试开发工程师（AI 量化 / Money·支付 / iPhone Duo）｜金融、交易所类系统测试，资金流与对账逻辑，Python 脚本能力
- 高级 App 提效测试工程师｜金融/支付/交易所测试团队管理或技术专家
- AI 测试工程师｜大模型应用测试，理解 Token、上下文、幻觉等概念

### SRE / AI
- 高级 SRE 工程师（AWS / 腾讯云）｜云原生运维，大型业务稳定性保障
- SRE 架构师｜运维架构设计、容灾与可观测性体系
- AI Agent 高级技术专家｜Agent / Tool Calling / MCP，有真实落地项目

### 产品
- AI 产品经理（C 端 Agent 方向 / B 端赋能方向）｜C 端或 B 端复杂产品经验，关注 AI 前沿
- Web3 产品经理｜链上交易平台、DEX、交易工具或数据产品经验
- 美股交易产品经理 / 美股期权产品经理 / 产品经理（股票公司行动）｜券商或交易所产品经验，熟悉订单、撮合、清结算、公司行动
- 支付产品经理 / 支付运营产品经理 / 支付解决方案经理｜法币+加密支付链路、渠道接入、清结算与合规
- 高级产品经理（充值提现 / 资金）｜CEX 或钱包出入金核心业务经验
- KYC 产品经理｜KYC / 合规流程产品设计
- 专业交易产品负责人 / 交易工具产品负责人 / 行情产品经理｜专业交易终端、跟单/量化、行情类产品
- 金融产品经理（IPO 打新方向）｜Launchpad / Launchpool / Airdrop 等产品经验
- 增长产品总监 / 社交产品高级经理·总监｜增长或社交产品规划与落地，大厂经验

### 风控 / 数据
- 资深风控策略专家（TradFi 方向）｜股票、期权或交易所衍生品风控策略
- 风控策略专家（支付方向 / 链上分析方向）｜支付反欺诈，或链上分析与追踪
- 活动风控策略专家｜营销风控、批量注册、账号治理
- 风控运营专员｜风险调查、案件分析、处置建议
- 数据分析师｜SQL 熟练，BI 工具，币圈或互联网大厂背景

### 设计
- 资深 UI 产品设计师｜交易所 / Web3 钱包 / 金融科技 UI/UX 全链路设计
- UX 设计师｜Figma，完整作品集（投递需附作品集链接）
- 组件设计师｜设计系统与组件库建设，附作品集

## 工作环境
全远程、亚太时区协作；线上 3 轮面试，1–2 周内出结果；岗位持续招聘，投递时请注明应聘职位，我们会按方向转给对应团队。

gh_7b0790eab0e7e8741e23914a.title: [Remoto] UX Designer na Botcity
gh_7b0790eab0e7e8741e23914a.description:
## Nossa empresa

BotCity is building the future of automation with the Governance Platform for Python automations and AI Agents. We empower enterprises to innovate at scale, bringing governance, control, and observability to every automation project. Our philosophy is simple: automation is software, and software deserves the same high-code standards that drive innovation in AI and machine learning.

We recently raised a $12M Series A, led by Four Rivers with participation from Y Combinator, SoftBank, and top industry leaders such as Lew Cirne (New Relic), Rod Johnson (Spring Source), and Walter Kortschak (Summit Partners | Firestreak Ventures). With 1,000+ customers in 70+ countries, including Bayer and LG, and recognition by G2 (2024) as one of the world’s top 25 emerging platforms, BotCity is scaling fast.

We’re a global remote company with teams across the US and LATAM, united by a shared vision to redefine how enterprises build and manage automation. If you’re looking for an environment that values impact, autonomy, and excellence, we’d love for you to join us on this journey.

## Descrição da vaga

Role Overview

The UX Designer will own the end-to-end design of features across our three product surfaces — platform, agent, and web portal — turning complex business and technical challenges into intuitive, responsive user experiences. This is a hands-on, generalist role for someone who thrives in the fast-paced, high-uncertainty environment of an early-stage B2B SaaS product. You will design from sketches and wireframes through high-fidelity prototypes and developer-ready specs, help us build our first Design System from the ground up, and support discovery alongside the team when opportunities arise. In this position, you will work closely with our UX Lead and partner directly with the PM (who is also our CTO)

 
Responsibilities

Design end-to-end: from initial sketches and wireframes to high-fidelity, responsive prototypes across the platform, agent, and web portal.
Produce high-fidelity screens and detailed specifications in Figma (English and pt-BR), ensuring the development team has everything needed for precise implementation.
Help build and evolve BotCity's first Design System — components, patterns, and tokens — in partnership with the UX Lead and the front-end team.
Analyze existing functionalities and propose UX improvements to reduce friction and enhance user efficiency.
Build interactive prototypes to test usability and communicate complex flows to stakeholders.
Support discovery alongside the UX Lead and the PM: run qualitative interviews, map user journeys, and validate hypotheses and prototypes with B2B clients when needed.
Transform findings into clear UX artifacts (User Journey Maps, Personas) and documented insights shared with the team.
Partner with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to ensure design solutions align with technical constraints and business goals.

## Local

Remoto

## Requisitos

Experience (3+ years) as a UX/Product Designer working end-to-end on digital products.
Demonstrable portfolio featuring end-to-end UX projects (from problem to delivered interface).
Strong UI and high-fidelity prototyping in Figma, at a level that supports end-to-end delivery.
Ability to design responsive interfaces across web (and mobile where applicable).
Experience building or contributing to Design Systems (components, patterns, tokens, libraries).
Comfortable supporting discovery: qualitative interviews, usability testing (remote or A/B), and mapping
Critical User Journeys.
Ability to translate findings into clear insights, opportunities, and recommendations.
Experience with Design Thinking and agile methodologies.
UX/usability tools (Figma, UserTesting, Maze); MS Office/Excel, Google Suite, Notion.
Ability to travel as needed to support events and meet the team.
Portuguese — Fluent.
English — Intermediary/Advanced.

**Desejáveis:**
Prior experience with B2B products.
Prior experience in an early-stage, high-growth, fast-paced startup environment.
Familiarity with technical products (developer tooling, automation, Python, or AI a plus).
Proven experience leading research, thematic analysis, and A/B testing.



## Contratação

PJ

## Como se candidatar

Enviar candidatura pela página de carreiras: https://jobs.quickin.io/botcity/jobs/6a482f8d0ad5470013bb28b3?src=Github

## Tempo médio de feedbacks

Costumamos enviar feedbacks em até 15 dias após cada processo.
E-mail para contato em caso de não haver resposta: recruiting@botcity.dev

## Labels
- Remoto
- PJ
- Pleno

gh_7b019f4a45224b8daa71263a.title: FutureLearn: Software Engineer
gh_7b019f4a45224b8daa71263a.description: **Tags:** #ruby #react #javascript #edtech #dev #engineer #digital-nomad #ruby **Published on:** October 29, 2021 **Original Job Post:** https://remoteOK.io/remote-jobs/106907-remote-software-engineer-futurelearn ![](https://remoteOK.io/assets/img/jobs/bc6733266566cc2333e27dfd535cc3811635521950.png) Department:Technology Type of Contract: Permanent Working Pattern: Full time Location: Remote (GMT +/- 2 hours), with optional London-based workspace About the Role Software Engineers at FutureLearn work in multidisciplinary product teams, collaborating with designers, other engineers, product managers and stakeholders. Cross-team collaboration is encouraged, and teams are flexible with people moving between them as needs change, so there's plenty of scope to become familiar with the whole platform. We work in short sprints & regularly share, reflect on and iterate on our work. This helps us focus on shipping small, iterative changes and responding quickly to changing business or user needs. Our platform uses the Ruby on Rails web framework along with the React JavaScript library with Typescript, and we use unit, integration and acceptance tests to drive design and keep everything working. Every engineer has the ability to deploy, and we deploy multiple times per day to a large-scale system on AWS, supported by our Site Reliability Engineers. Key Responsibilities As a software engineer at FutureLearn you’ll collaborate in a multidisciplinary product team to deliver working software that has an impact on your team’s metrics. This will include writing Ruby and JavaScript to deliver new features for our users, as well as refactoring our codebase to make it more pleasant and productive to work on. You’ll be comfortable writing modular code and thinking about how your work fits into the big picture, and collaborating with our data engineers to make use of our reporting and analysis. You’ll have strong communication skills, and be comfortable discussing problems and solutions with your team-mates. You’ll be asked to give your input & ideas to help make decisions and shape features via design sprints, planning, story mapping and other product development activities. You’ll enjoy learning, teaching & sharing your experience with your colleagues in various ways; we encourage code review, pairing, mentoring, giving (and watching!) regular lightning talks, and getting & giving regular feedback. Requirements We’re looking for people with experience with Ruby and Rails. Experience with JavaScript, React in particular, TypeScript, GraphQL and Next.js would also be valuable. You’ll have previous experience building, maintaining and deploying a large interactive web application at scale, taking into account performance, security and maintainability. You’ll have experience writing high-value tests and have a good understanding of software design principles. Ideally you’ll also have experience of incrementally improving a large legacy codebase and shaping it into sensible, well-organised modular components, alongside delivering features in a cross-functional agile product team. Benefits Salary: £45k-60k (mid) or £60k-75k (senior) depending on experience 28 days holiday (plus 8 days public holiday) Buy & sell up to 5 days holiday Westfield Healthcare Cash Plan Free access to Calm app Dedicated personal learning & development budget Charity day (volunteer for a charity of your choice) Cycle to work scheme Season Ticket loan Flexible working environment/hours Pension (4% employer / employee contribution) About FutureLearn FutureLearn is a leading social learning platform formed in December 2012 by The Open University and is now jointly owned by The Open University and The SEEK Group. FutureLearn has over 10 million people signed up worldwide. FutureLearn uses design, technology and partnerships to create enjoyable, credible and flexible short online courses, microcredentials, as well as undergraduate and postgraduate degrees that improve working lives. It partners with over a quarter of the world’s top universities, as well as organisations such as Accenture, the British Council, CIPD, Raspberry Pi and Health Education England (HEE). It’s also involved in government-backed initiatives to address skills gaps such as The Institute of Coding and the National Centre for Computing Education. Applications Please use our online form by pressing 'Apply for this job' below, including your CV and a cover letter telling us why you'd like to come work with us. Software Engineer interview process We do an initial competency interview which consists of some screening questions, like checking your right to work in the UK (unfortunately we can’t sponsor visas), and your experience in our hiring competencies. This first interview has two purposes: it's a chance for you to ask questions about how we work, and for us to find out what you're looking for from your next role. We'll also be interested to find out more about your curiosity, initiative, technical, communication and teamwork skills. So we'll be interested to talk about things like: your approach to dealing with difficult situations like dealing with conflicting or ambiguous requirements, how you communicate your work with others and how you learn new things and teach others. The final stage interview consists of a pairing session with one of our engineers. You'll also get the opportunity to meet a couple of people from the Product org to ask any further questions. How we assess candidates We use a set of competencies to evaluate candidates throughout the interview process: communication, initiative, teamwork, curiosity and technical skill. You can read more about these in our blog post about our hiring framework. Recruitment Process Please contact [email protected] if you require any reasonable adjustments or alterations to be made, to support you through the recruitment process. Diversity Statement We value all the great benefits that diversity brings and encourage everyone to bring their whole self at work, regardless of gender, religion, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age or disability. COVID19 We encourage freelancers and people who have been made redundant as a result of COVID-19 to apply for opportunities at FutureLearn. We believe that in these difficult times, good employers have to rise to the occasion and play their part in the community. At FutureLearn, we take care of each other. Be sure to mention the words **TALENT RURAL GUILT** when applying to show you read the job post completely. This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human. #Salary and compensation No salary data published by company so we estimated salary based on previous jobs related to . $50,000 — $110,000/year ### Location Remote (Gmt +/- 2 Hours), with Optional London-Based Workspace
